description: Cancel or move a Kamchatka tour request by its status key when the person asks; the call returns a Vedar link, the person confirms there. Key from create_booking_request; call only when the person asked. The call changes nothing: give the person confirm_url; only their click on the Vedar page changes the request. Then: operator has not answered yet — cancelled or moved at once; already answered, booked or agreed — a request goes to the operator, who decides. A request is not a booking. A cancelled request cannot be restored. Moves only to a date with seats for everyone (get_tour_availability), at most three a day. A repeat-call key or another request's key cannot change it. Pass outcome, changed and told to the person as is.

action.description: cancel to cancel the request; change_date to move it to the date in the date field.

date.description: New tour date, YYYY-MM-DD; required for change_date.

key.description: Status key from the create_booking_request reply that created the request, as is (20–120 characters).

test.description: true for a dry run: the reply says what would happen; nothing is changed or sent.

name: change_request

changed.description: true — this call changed the request; a request to the operator does not

confirm_url.description: Vedar page where the person confirms; give it as is. null — nothing to confirm

date.description: Current request date after the call, YYYY-MM-DD

outcome.description: One-word outcome. cancelled; cancel_requested — the operator cancels, request passed on, the request stands; cancel_request_undelivered — reached nobody, the request stands, retry; date_changed; date_change_requested — the operator decides; date_change_request_undelivered; no_seats — not enough seats on that date; no_schedule; daily_limit — three moves or requests today; date_refused_by_operator — operator already said no seats; closed, past, no_data — nothing to change; would_* — dry run; confirm_on_page — unchanged: the person confirms via confirm_url

test.description: true — dry run: nothing stored or sent

told.description: Who was actually told: operator; manager (operator not reached); nobody; null — nothing to tell

title: Change request
